classificationDefinitions.ENFORCED: an executable artefact proves it (test, verifier script, migration, policy or machine-checked contract match) and, where a boundary is declared, a real call site invokes it
classificationDefinitions.DECLARED: a module, document or contract mentions it, but nothing executable proves it
classificationDefinitions.IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED: implementation and tests exist, but the declared boundary patterns match nothing — the capability protects nothing yet

ownership.note: Phase 14 owns catalog metadata, classification, quality, lineage and governed data-access contracts. Domain tables, universal memory/knowledge graphs and authorization decisions remain owned by their respective phases.

areas.requirement: A dataset has an owning phase/domain and an explicit classification; invalid ownership or classification input is refused.

areas.area: The catalog discovers datasets without crossing tenants
areas.requirement: Catalog registration and search preserve dataset metadata and never return another tenant's dataset.

areas.area: Invalid data is measured, quarantined and replay-safe
areas.requirement: Quality rules reject invalid records, quarantine preserves a reason, and replay with the same key does not duplicate effects.

areas.area: Lineage and query policy are explicit
areas.requirement: Lineage stays within the tenant and governed queries require tenant, bound and classification constraints.

areas.area: Retention, legal hold and residency are governed
areas.requirement: Retention and transfer decisions are represented as policy decisions, including legal holds and prohibited cross-border transfer.

areas.area: Migration, job and ingestion contracts are declared
areas.requirement: Forward-only migration, restartable job, authorised ingestion and reconciliation contracts exist as libraries; their live callers are not implied.

areas.area: Physical storage and runtime enforcement remain open
areas.requirement: A real storage layer and database, scheduler or gateway boundary must enforce these contracts; the current report records that they are absent.

limitations: Classification measures the presence of executable evidence, not the correctness or completeness of that evidence.
A DECLARED area is unfinished work, never a false claim — it is reported as such.
An IMPLEMENTED_UNWIRED area has a tested implementation that no boundary calls; it is reported, never counted as enforcement.
Evidence patterns are declared per phase in architecture/phase-acceptance/phase-<id>-*.json and must be reviewed when a phase is re-audited.
